newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian shares end higher, Solvay lags.
newsitem.headline: Belgian shares end higher, Solvay lags.

text.p: 1610 GMT - Belgian shares end firmer on Monday, though below the day's best levels and amid some caution for the immediate term after Wall Street .DJI turned lower. Analysts generally optimistic for Belgian shares in medium to longer term.

* Bel-20 index .BFX closes 8.08 points or 0.39 percent higher at 2.088.58 after peaking at 2,090.79. Volume at 2.6 billion francs worth of Belgian shares, well below daily average of 4.2 billion during the month of January.
* Chemicals stock Solvay falls 1.7 percent to 21,950 francs amid continued disappointment over 1996 preliminary profit figures published last week and the ensuing broker downgrades.
